message.content: For soccer practice, Li Hua and Caspian initially mentioned a plan to meet around 3 PM on Saturday afternoon. Specifically, Li Hua stated, "Sounds good! I’m in! It'll be a great way to enhance our skills and enjoy some time outside. What time do you plan to meet up?" In response, Caspian replied, "3 PM sounds perfect to me! I think practicing together will help us improve our teamwork too. Looking forward to seeing everyone!" Therefore, the planned meeting time for soccer practice is 3 PM on Saturday afternoon.
